info.name: YouTube Analytics Analytics Groups Group Items API

params.name: groupId
params.description: The group ID to retrieve items for

params.name: onBehalfOfContentOwner
params.description:
The content owner ID for YouTube content owner operations.
Required for content owner authenticated requests.

params.name: prettyPrint
params.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks for readability

items.docs:
Returns a collection of group items that match the API request parameters.
Group items represent the individual channels or videos that belong to
an analytics group.

params.name: onBehalfOfContentOwner
params.description:
The content owner ID for YouTube content owner operations.
Required for content owner authenticated requests.

items.docs:
Adds a channel or video to an analytics group. The item will be included
in the group's aggregated analytics data going forward.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The unique identifier of the group item

params.name: onBehalfOfContentOwner
params.description:
The content owner ID for YouTube content owner operations.
Required for content owner authenticated requests.

items.docs:
Removes a channel or video from an analytics group. The item's historical
data will no longer be included in the group's aggregated metrics.
